notes.title: Working on the next update.
notes.content:
Since I will be working on the next update, which will take some time, I am making this informational note for users who have already purchased NeonCyber.exe, and also to thank them.

I want to thank you for investing in my video game, which I will be working hard on to ensure you enjoy new features, making it feel like purchasing the game was absolutely worth it.

The features currently planned for the next update are as follows.

[h1]alpha v - 0.1.0[/h1]

[b][Fixed Errors][/b]

[list]
[*] The camera movement system was not functioning correctly.
[*] The animation when loading the results screen was not functioning correctly.
[*] There were issues with sound settings.
[/list]

[b][Modifications][/b]

[list]
[*] The programming code has been organized and modified.
[*] The wall-running system has been refined and improved.
[*] Performance has been slightly optimized.
[*] The menu interface has been modified.
[*] New effects and particles have been added.
[*] Graphics have been slightly modified.
[/list]

[b][Additions][/b]

[list]
[*] A tutorial has been added.
[*] An internal map editor has been added.
[*] A total of 8 difficulties have been added, each with 200 maps.
[*] Background scenarios have been modified, and each difficulty will show a different scenario.
[*] Achievements have been added.
[*] Leaderboards have been added.
[*] Steam Cloud has been added.
[/list]
